_schema._about: Copy for the home hero (partials/home/hero.html). Every string here is visible copy; keep British English, sentence case, no 'studio', no client claims. The hotel walkthrough's keys are retired; 'stops' stays because /process reads stops[0] for its header card.
_schema.stops: array[5] in camera order. {id: matches the drawing group suffix exactly ('1-front-of-house' → detail group id '#1-front-of-house', fade group '#1-fade'); label: HUD list button text; title: HUD card title (26px display); description: HUD card body (14px, the reference site 10–17 words); panel: src/panels/<panel>.html name per CONTRACT §9; bbox: {x,y,w,h} of the room slot in SVG units (CONTRACT §8); camera: {cx, cy, w} = bbox centre and bbox.w × 1.25 in SVG units — the engine derives h = w / stageAspect}.
_schema.marquee: {ariaLabel, items[6]: {name, file, alt}}. The six placements hypjam ships to (CONTRACT §10). file = monochrome typographic wordmark SVGs drawn by us, opacity .5, path relative to site root; they do not exist yet — the assets/marquee agent creates them at exactly these paths.
_schema.cta: object {href, label, secondaryHref, secondaryLabel}. The prominent hero CTA row under the trust paragraph: a primary Book a call button (--dark --lg) and a secondary ghost link. Same destination as the nav pill and footer CTA (/book).
_schema.terms: array[3] of {k, v}: the key/value terms row under the sub (price floor, first-cuts clause, term). Rendered as a <dl>; on phones the keys are visually hidden and the values read as one line.
_schema.work: array[3] of {format, credit, creditShort, poster, video, alt, play}: the three example ads, poster only until pressed. Captions are the owner's own wording (he confirmed 'made for Cluely', '@this_avi.ag, ex-Cluely' and '@ajain_ugc, ex-Replit creator'). Posters are hook frames with no third-party logos.
_schema.workLabel: small DM Mono label above the three example ads (aria-hidden; the list has its own aria-label).
